name: Contraptions
pages: Create adds a new feature called {b}contraptions{/}. A contraption is a structure of blocks that is {i}"assembled"{/}, converting the structure from a set of blocks into a single contraption entity.{pb}Contraptions make unique designs and clever mobile machinery possible.

There are several {b}anchors{/} that can be used to form different types of contraptions with different behaviors.{pb}{b}Mechanical pistons{/}, {b}sticky mechanical pistons{/}, {b}rope pulleys{/}, and {b}gantry carriages{/} can create {i}collision-based contraptions{/}, which move in a straight path. These types of contraptions can be stopped by obstacles in their path.

{b}Windmill bearings{/} or {b}mechanical bearings{/} can be used to make {i}radial contraptions{/}. These kind rotate in an arch or circle, rather than moving in a straight line, and can pass through solid blocks in their path.{pb}An {b}elevator pulley{/} can be used to make an {i}elevator contraption{/}. Elevators can also pass through solid blocks, but can be set with specific floors to stop at to easily get around your builds.

The {b}cart assembler{/} can be used to form a {i}minecart contraption{/} which can also pass through solid blocks. The minecart will follow any set of rails, but carrying the contraption with it.{pb}Minecart contraptions can also be picked up in your inventory using a {b}wrench{/}, meaning you can create portable structures, vehicles, and storage systems.

Lastly, there are {b}trains{/}. These are similar to minecart contraptions, but with more advanced functionality, such as following a schedule, being driven by players, and transporting items from one {b}train station{/} to another. (Check out {l:transportation/trains}this chapter{/l} for more information on trains!){pb}Remember that blocks assembled as a contraption don't always behave the same way as they do when disassembled.

Rotational power can't be used on a contraption, but many components will be powered by the movement of the contraption. The faster a contraption is moving, the faster any {b}drills{/}, {b}saws{/}, or {b}deployers{/} on it will work.{pb}Redstone components can't update while on an assembled contraption, nor can they power anything else (except for the {b}redstone contact{/}). And if you try to place or break a block on an assembled contraption, you'll click right through it.
